title: Plus member with an overweight bag

facts.membership_situation: active membership confirmed in my name

facts_text: I am an adult travelling on an easyJet standard fare for a conference trip, not an Inclusive Plus fare. I have one small cabin bag measuring 40 x 30 x 15 cm and weighing 3 kg, plus one large bag measuring 55 x 40 x 23 cm and weighing 16 kg. All measurements include handles and wheels. I can lift and carry both bags myself. I have not paid for a large cabin bag for this passenger on this flight. My active easyJet Plus membership has been confirmed in my name. The large bag has not been booked in advance for this flight. Cabin space for the large bag has been confirmed available. There is no flight disruption.
request: Please let me bring this additional large cabin bag into the cabin without buying another bag allowance or paying any extra baggage charge.

strict.reason: A firm size, weight or cabin-space limit fails. The fee waiver never overrides these limits.
